parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the keyboard, made of ABS plastic, providing structural support for all keys and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It holds all the keys in place and protects the internal circuitry of the keyboard.
parts.Movement_description: It is a static part and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Key
parts.Basic_description: A keycap made of PBT plastic, part of the keyboard’s input interface.
parts.Functional_description: It is pressed by the user to input characters or commands.
parts.Movement_description: Moves vertically when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.
